entities.name: Vladimír Neff
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vladimír Neff was a Czech writer and translator. He wrote numerous historical novels, political satires, and parodies on criminal stories and adventure tales. He was declared as a National Artist of Czechoslovakia in 1979.

entities.summary: Vladimír Neff was a Czech writer and translator. He wrote numerous historical novels, political satires, and parodies on criminal stories and adventure tales. He was declared as a National Artist of Czechoslovakia in 1979.
